Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The urine findings show significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrite positivity, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, consistent with a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and mild proteinuria are also noted. Low specific gravity may indicate dilute urine. No casts or ketones detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antimicrobial therapy.
